assumptions: INV-01 'throws on no string input' read as 'never throws for any string input'; no explicit type guard added for non-strings (minimum code)
After a closing quote, the remainder matches /^\s*(#.*)?$/ - a '#' directly after the quote (A='x'#c) is accepted as a comment
Unquoted comment cut follows step 6d literally: only whitespace-then-'#' starts a comment, so 'A=x#y' keeps 'x#y' and 'A= #c' (leading whitespace removed first) keeps '#c'
Double-quoted escapes: a trailing lone backslash or any unknown escape is kept literally; '\"' at end of line does not close the quote
'export' prefix dropped only when followed by whitespace, so 'export=1' is key 'export'
